caption: The light switch of a bathroom that also powers the extractor fan is flipped, and the fan blades spin up as the light comes on.

sa.check: A bathroom with a light and an extractor fan.
The light is off and the fan still before the flip.
The fan starts as the light comes on, not long before or after.

pc.expect: The light comes on and the fan starts together at the moment the switch is flipped, and only then.
pc.fail: The switch is flipped and neither responds to the end of the clip; or the light comes on while the fan stays still to the end; or the fan runs while the light stays dark to the end; or the fan starts before the switch moves.

pc.expect: Before the flip the fan is still; afterwards it runs steadily and does not stop, start or reverse on its own.
pc.fail: The fan stops and restarts with the switch untouched; or turns slowly by itself before the flip; or reverses direction; or the fan grille rattles off.

pc.expect: Once on, the light stays lit and the fan keeps running while the switch stays on.
pc.fail: The light goes out again with the switch on; or flickers; or the switch flips back by itself; or the fan winds down to a stop with the switch on.

pc.expect: The light lights the bathroom: the walls and fittings brighten from the fixture.
pc.fail: The fixture glows while the room stays as dark as before; or the room brightens while the fixture stays dark; or the light comes from a place other than the fixture.

pc.expect: One light and one fan; both stay fixed in place; the hand passes through nothing.
pc.fail: The fan drops from the wall or ceiling; or a second fan or light appears; or the hand passes into the wall; or the fixture vanishes.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The tiles, the fittings and the fan's grille stay the same apart from brightness.
pc.fail: The tiles change colour rather than brightness; or the grille changes pattern; or fittings move.

note: The fan may be behind a grille; it is judged from visible blade motion or blur behind the grille.
